response.overview: Essential Documents for Verification 🆔 To complete the Venmo verify identity process, you will need several key documents ready ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. Ensure all documents are current, clear, and not expired to avoid processing delays ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. Commonly requested items include:  A valid Government-issued identification card, such as a driver's license or passport ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. Your full legal name and current residential address ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. Your Date of Birth to confirm you meet the age requirements for an account ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. Your Social Security Number (SSN) for tax and regulatory purposes ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. A "selfie" verification to match your face with your provided identification ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️.
